sloka: तेन संचोदितौ तौ तु राक्षसौ च महाबलौ ।मारीचः च सुबाहुः च यज्ञ विघ्नम् करिष्यतः ॥१-२०-१९॥
transliteration: tena saṁcoditau tau tu rākṣasau ca mahābalau ।mārīcaḥ ca subāhuḥ ca yajña vighnam kariṣyataḥ ॥1-20-19॥

translations.english: Although endowed with great strength, Ravana, by himself, never created impediments to the sacrifice. But two rakshasas by name Maricha and Subahu are incited by him to cause obstacles".
